maintenance_window.scope: Conservative interval spanning the first failed pre-migration attempt and successful retry; receiver was restored between attempts.

rollout_notes: The deployed API and dedicated Quant worker use a separate release; Paper worker and market stream keep their preceding code.
The migration is additive, base schema stays 14, and a protected pre-migration backup exists.
One attempt aborted before DB migration due to a port-format precondition; prior API/Paper worker were restored before the successful retry.
Market candles continued during the conservative receiver-maintenance interval; natural webhook continuity must account for that interval.
Default git archive excludes Quant Lab; the matching tracked Python source was supplied as a separate controlled bundle.
The deployed engine byte fingerprint is recorded separately because Git archive normalizes source line endings.
The existing Quant Python environment was reused without changing its packages or production service.
Source approval and the two Bridge grids validated under the restricted staging runtime role inside an intentionally rolled-back transaction.
No research job was committed, no new owner optimization was started and no strategy performance result was selected.
